verdict.rationale: iTerm2 ships its own documented Python package for scripts that control the terminal, described as 'full automation and customization via Python'. It also has AppleScript support for launching the app and opening sessions in new tabs or windows, and community users praise the Python API hands-on. This is a documented control API an agent could drive, though the evidence never lists the individual operations the story asks for. missing for 10: explicit evidence of creating split panes, sending commands and reading session output through the API, and agent-oriented documentation (llms.txt and markdown docs return 404)
